provenance_taxonomy.licensed_corpus_extraction: A sentence selected directly from an existing licensed corpus (e.g. BHT25 native Telugu). Preserves source record ID, corpus, license, and source grouping information. Subject to 100% human verification.
provenance_taxonomy.naturally_occurring: An authentic utterance collected from organic discourse with appropriate permission and platform-rule compliance.
provenance_taxonomy.human_elicited: An original sentence intentionally authored by a multilingual contributor in response to a communication scenario. Preserves pseudonymous contributor ID and contributor consent.
provenance_taxonomy.parallel_reference: A human-authored code-mixed sentence composed by a contributor using parallel text as a semantic reference. Preserves reference dataset, reference record ID, reference license, and author consent.
provenance_taxonomy.automatically_generated: PROHIBITED. Synthetic text generated by AI/LLMs is strictly ineligible as ground-truth data in this project.

canonical_top_level.source_record_id: Canonical top-level field allowing string or null. Null is appropriate for direct human elicitation; required and non-null for corpus extraction and parallel reference. Not duplicated in metadata.

canonical_spelling.license: Standardized canonical spelling license and license_url throughout schema, manifest, and validator.

licensed_corpus_extraction.contributor_id: Must be null (public corpus records do not have individual contributor consent)

parallel_reference.license: Reference source license and attribution preserved
parallel_reference.concatenation_rule: Automatic concatenation of parallel source sentences strictly prohibited

bht25_source_group_investigation.literature_identified_in_paper: Translations of Rabindranath Tagore and Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay works
bht25_source_group_investigation.record_level_work_traceability: Cannot be reconstructed automatically from raw Parquet fields without external full-text alignment
bht25_source_group_investigation.investigation_result: UNRESOLVED in raw corpus. Claiming a leakage-free document-group split without source information is barred. Sourcing Category A records from BHT25 requires manual work attribution or documented approved grouping exception before split.
bht25_source_group_investigation.split_script_enforcement: split_custom_trilingual_dataset.py strictly refuses to split records lacking valid source_group_id

language_switch_count.algorithm: Sequential traversal of language-bearing tokens (EN, HI, TE); increments count when current token differs from previous language-bearing token; ignores OTHER, NE, MIXED, AMBIGUOUS, and null.
